summary: Keep atomic evidence independent of index rebuilds

delivery.outcome: Fix semcod/planfile#297 by avoiding disposable-index repair inside the atomic evidence write transaction while preserving all mutation and evidence guards.
nonGoals: No API/package runtime deployment, dependency, governance, index configuration or credential changes.
No lock removal, unknown-process interruption, stale CAS bypass, source ticket takeover or modification of native Reflex19955 inputs/attempt/budget.
Do not restart expired campaigns or change Validator findings.

architecture.decision: Use existing Store.get_ticket(repair_index=False) for the exact authoritative lookup already inside append_ticket_evidence mutation_lock. Add real separate-process index/mutation lock contention tests, preserving journal, duplicate/conflict and state semantics. Do not alter general read/rebuild behavior or bypass locks.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded material source change through governed publication; preserve all evidence journals, lock files and native task history.
